description: Use when finding any existing Postlyra post, including scheduled, published or archived content. Search owner content by words, status, connected channel and update dates. Read the selected post with get_post.

channelId.description: Owner-bound channel id from list_channels; never invent a recipient.

from.description: Inclusive lower update-time bound as ISO 8601 with UTC offset, e.g. 2026-10-28T09:00:00+07:00.

includeArchived.description: Include archived posts in results; false by default unless status=archived.

limit.description: Maximum items to return in this page; observe the schema bounds.

offset.description: Zero-based number of matching items to skip; use nextOffset from the preceding page.

query.description: Keywords or fragments in the post title and body; all terms must match. Empty or omitted lists posts.

status.description: Filter by the post status, e.g. draft or published.

to.description: Inclusive upper update-time bound as ISO 8601 with UTC offset, e.g. 2026-10-28T18:00:00+07:00.

name: search_posts
title: Search Postlyra content
